notes.title: Game update for the animated scenes.
notes.content: [p]We have fixed the WIN 11 update compatibility issue which caused the red screen during the animated scenes, and the game update is now live.[/p][p]Thanks to all for reporting and hope you will enjoy better the game. [/p]

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
An updated version of the game is now online.
Fixed a few minor UI visual issues in the game and some CGs that were not properly displayed in the DLC.
